about.name: Morpho
about.description: Morpho is a permissionless decentralized lending platform that operates on two levels: it offers tailored solutions for users to earn and borrow on their terms and provides a flexible infrastructure stack that empowers developers and businesses to build custom applications. Morpho's unique value lies in offering users the ability to tailor their own risk-reward profile by selecting from curated vaults, markets, or products.
about.categoryNote: Morpho has no category of its own on DefiLlama, so this is the category of the sub-protocols with the most fees over 30 days.

unlocks.summary: Founders' tokens (15.2% of supply) vest linearly from November 21, 2025 to November 21, 2027, after a one-year lockup. Strategic partners' third cohort vests over the same window.

schedules.label: Founders (15.2% of supply)
schedules.basis: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028.

schedules.label: Strategic partners, cohort 3
schedules.basis: The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

events.label: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends

token.name: Morpho
token.description: Morpho is an open, efficient, and resilient platform that allows anyone to earn yield and borrow assets. Lenders can earn on Morpho using Morpho Vaults, noncustodial simple to use lending vaults that optimize yields for depositors.
